title: VCMI battle action format
description: Format used to define battle actions of units in VCMI

index.description: Fixed number of a built-in action. Reserved for the core mod

script.description: Identifier of the battleAction script with the rules of the action

trigger.description: Bonus types that grant the action. The unit gets one option of the action per distinct subtype of these bonuses. Without a trigger, the action is offered to every unit

type.description: Bonus type, or list of bonus types

priority.description: Order in which the client tries the actions of a unit for a hovered hex, lower first. Used when the script returns no priority of its own

button.description: Button of the unit action panel that selects the action

order.description: Position of the button in the panel, lower first

tooltip.description: Tooltip of the button, or identifier of existing text prefixed with '@'

turnStatus.description: Turn status of the unit once the action starts. 'keep' leaves the status as it is. Default is 'acted'

usesUnitSpellcast.description: The action uses up the spellcasting of the unit for the turn

tacticsAction.description: The action is allowed during the tactics phase
